# Running the demo

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  eval = FALSE
)
```

The public PBMC demo runs the `immune_human_2x` aggregation through every configured review checkpoint. Run this from a repository-root R session after completing [Installation](installation.qmd).

```{r}
targets::tar_make(
  names =
    targets::tar_described_as(
      tidyselect::matches(
        "checkpoint:(GEX|ATAC|multimodal|differential_analyses|genetic_enrichment)"
      )
    ) &
    tidyselect::matches("immune_human_2x")
)
```

The run writes target artifacts to `pipelines/processing_and_aggregation/outputs`, the `targets` store configured in `_targets.yaml`. After the run completes, use the target names shown in the [Output Gallery](output_gallery.qmd) with `targets::tar_read()` to inspect representative outputs from the same repository-root R session.
